title: Mica next to other Git-based editors.
lead: Six other products also keep content in Git. This page puts them next to Mica, point by point, and says where each one is the better choice. Mica is also ready for AI agents: an MCP server is built in. Each product has its own page with the details and the sources.
changeNote: These products change often. Read their documentation before you decide.

rows.label: Content in Git, and which hosts
rows.mica: Yes. Any Git host, with plain Git and no host API. The self-hosted editor pushes over HTTPS only, not SSH.

rows.label: Runs without the vendor's service
rows.mica: Yes. The local editor, or one container that you run. No hosted offering yet. A Mica Cloud is planned.

rows.label: Licence and price
rows.mica: MIT. Free. You run it yourself.

rows.label: Astro support
rows.mica: Official package. Content reaches Astro as Content Collections, with types.

rows.label: Sign-in for editors
rows.mica: Local editor: none, loopback only. Self-hosted: any OpenID Connect provider.

rows.label: Save and publish
rows.mica: A save writes a draft. Publish makes one commit of the changes the editor chooses.

rows.label: Preview and visual editing
rows.mica: Live preview in the local editor and in the self-hosted Mica, with click to edit. No full visual editing.

rows.label: Many large photos and files (Git LFS)
rows.mica: Yes. Large media stay out of the normal Git history, with Git LFS, in the local and the self-hosted editor.

rows.label: External data (products, places, codes)
rows.mica: Yes. Entries link to items of a JSON or CSV file of your website, thousands of them, which Mica never edits.

rows.label: Map field
rows.mica: Yes. It stores latitude, longitude and zoom.

rows.label: Roles and review
rows.mica: No roles. Review with a staging branch and a second Mica.

rows.label: AI agents (MCP)
rows.mica: Built in, free: an MCP server for local and self-hosted editing. Agents save drafts; Mica checks each value.
